For Sale in Dose North Coast with a Stunning Direct Sea & Lagoon View

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Dose North Coast is one of the most prestigious coastal developments in Ras El Hekma, developed by Akam Al Rajhi Developments to offer a luxurious and private seaside lifestyle. The project enjoys a prime location on the Mediterranean coast and features contemporary architectural designs that provide stunning views of the sea and crystal lagoons, complemented by expansive green landscapes that create a relaxing atmosphere.

Dose offers a full range of premium amenities, including swimming pools, a clubhouse, a commercial area, restaurants and cafés, children's entertainment zones, walking and cycling tracks, as well as 24/7 security and maintenance services. Thanks to its strategic location, diverse selection of units, and flexible payment plans, Dose North Coast is an ideal choice for those looking for a luxurious summer home or a promising real estate investment in one of the fastest-growing destinations on Egypt's North Coast.
